integrity: The claimed optimum and equality layer are reconstructed by an exhaustive finite census over all six- and seven-subsets of the 31 nonzero binary length-five vectors. Two equivalent predicates are checked on every candidate, and a separate complete search plus symmetry replay agrees with the census.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to binary (5,n,2,1) X-codes. No claim is made for other dimensions, error/unknown parameters, or nonbinary X-codes. Two 2003 proceedings sources were available only through abstracts/metadata, leaving a residual risk of an obscure finite statement.
title: Every optimal five-output two-error one-unknown X-code is \(K_{2,3}\)
